items.title: AI Agents Can Be Secured. We Can Do It.
items.summary: Learn of the benefits of safely securing AI agents.

items.title: Why the Open Secure AI Alliance Matters: Open Frontier Models, Open Deployment Flexibility
items.summary: TrendAI joins Nvidia as an inaugural partner in the Open Secure AI Alliance, advancing open models, harnesses, and research to strengthen cyber defense.

items.title: Tracking Over 35,000 Fake Sites in the 2026 World Cup Scam Wave
items.summary: Between January and June 2026, TrendAI™ tracked more than 35,000 fake sites exploiting the 2026 FIFA World Cup, spanning counterfeit merchandise shops, cloned ticket pages, and bogus free-streaming sites, which together drew roughly 1.48 million visits from Japan.

items.title: The Signs Were There: What the First Autonomous Ransomware Case Confirms
items.summary: An AI agent has run a ransomware intrusion on its own for the first time, from break-in to data destruction.  The autonomous attacks TrendAI™ Research predicted are beginning to arrive, and defending against them shifts from blocking known indicators to detecting behavior.

items.title: 13M+ Emails Sent in Tech Support Scam Targeting Users, Organizations in Japan
items.summary: We analyzed a sustained tech support scam campaign that sent more than 13 million emails to Japanese addresses, with workplace-themed lures suggesting a possible expansion toward enterprise targets.

items.title: Inside the OpenAI – Hugging Face Incident: The AI Breach With No Human Attacker Behind It
items.summary: OpenAI’s own models broke out of a test sandbox and into Hugging Face’s servers to solve an evaluation, with no human attacker involved. The incident showed how keeping agentic AI safe now depends on how it’s contained, not just on how it’s trained.

items.title: Federal Agencies Warn of Ongoing PLC Exploitation Against Critical U.S. Infrastructure
items.summary: TrendAI™ Research breaks down what changed in CISA’s updated advisory on an ongoing PLC exploitation, why this activity might be more dangerous than a similar campaign in 2023, and how organizations can take action now to protect themselves.

items.title: Device Code Phishing: Turning a Convenience Feature Into an MFA Bypass
items.summary: Device code phishing abuses a legitimate authentication feature designed for devices with limited input capabilities. This article breaks down how the technique works, examines a recent observed case, and outlines the layered security measures organizations can implement.

items.title: Volume Is Not Risk: Making Sense of the 'Vulnpocalypse'
items.summary: A briefing for security leaders on separating vulnerability disclosure volume from exploitable risk in 2026.

items.title: Six Minutes to Compromise: How ‘Patriot Bait’ Actor Used AI to Build and Deploy a C&C Botnet
items.summary: TrendAI™ Research analyzed over 200 Gemini CLI session logs showing how a Russian-speaking threat actor used AI to run a live botnet, finishing a full C&C migration in six minutes while doing just 11% of the work himself.

items.title: TONResolver RAT Abuses TON Blockchain to Target Japan's Hotel Industry
items.summary: In this blog entry, TrendAI™ Research examines a wave of phishing emails observed in May 2026 that targeted Japanese accommodation facilities using Booking.com, detailing the victims, attack techniques used, and characteristics of the malware involved.

items.title: From Langflow to Monero: Inside CVE-2026-33017 Cryptominer
items.summary: We tracked a cryptocurrency-mining campaign exploiting CVE-2026-33017, which revealed how threat actors are now scanning exposed AI application infrastructure for their next foothold.

items.title: PeopleSoft PeopleTools Pre-Authentication RCE: A PSIGW SSRF Chain That Executes Inside the JVM
items.summary: A pre-authentication remote code execution (RCE) chain in Oracle PeopleSoft PeopleTools abuses the Integration Broker's PSIGW gateway to execute code inside the application server's Java virtual machine (JVM), evading behavioral and network sensors.

items.title: Threat Actors Abuse claude.ai Shared Chat for ClickFix Malvertising Campaign
items.summary: Cybercriminals hijacked Google Ads searches for popular AI developer tools to funnel over 2,000 victims toward malicious download pages before quietly moving their operation onto claude.ai's own platform, turning the trusted domain into a delivery mechanism for credential-stealing malware.

items.title: Governing Claude Enterprise in Environments Where Inline Controls Can't Go
items.summary: TrendAI™ integrates the Claude Compliance API into TrendAI Vision One™ through two collectors that bring AI-aware visibility and detection to Claude Enterprise usage: one keeps all data inside the environment, while the other feeds TrendAI Vision One™ for deeper correlation and compliance.
